commit.message:
spec : add probabilistic sampling for simple draft and MTP (#27694)

* Make the drafter probabilistic and the target verify by rejection sampling

* Drop stale spec_draft_q before drafting

* Fallback to argmax sampling for grammar-constrained requests and adding flag for enabling probabilistic draft sampling. Default flag value is greedy.

* Support grammar-constrained requests in rejection sampling

* Fix - renormalize distribution after masking

* copy rng on sampler copy and re-accept drafted tokens on replay

* Fix draft sampler sharing the target's rng stream

* Simplify the rejection sampler's inputs and move replay to the server

* Truncate the draft candidates along with the draft

---------

Co-authored-by: Pranesh Gonegandla <pgonegandla@nvidia.com>
